title: Old Ninety's Glass
hook: Old Ninety's trailer. If you cannot see his mirrors, he cannot.
scene: Overcast midday on 167. A rogue semi with no door marks and a dirty number that used to be ninety fills the rear glass, then the left. Old Ninety. You are beside a trailer that has rooms a Ledger understands. If you cannot see his west-coasts, you are nowhere. The schedule wants you past him. Nowhere wants you first.
decision: You are coming up on Old Ninety's left rear quarter. Where do you sit?

options.text: Hold beside the trailer — his length is a windbreak and the left is empty
options.result: You cruise the no-zone. He starts a right that needs your lane. You are the car in the statistic. He never had you in the glass.

options.text: Tuck under his tail — if you cannot see him he cannot hit you
options.result: You sit in the hole behind a loaded trailer. He cannot see you and he cannot stop for you. The next brake is yours.

options.text: Pass on the shoulder — the rumble is safer than his left
options.result: The shoulder is a drain and a sign post. You put a bus in the junk. He never knew you tried.

options.text: Drop back until both his mirrors show you, or commit the pass and clear
options.result: You fall back until two dirty west-coasts hold a Ledger. Then you pass once, all the way, and you do not linger. He keeps his rooms. You keep your steel.

debrief: If you cannot see a truck's mirrors, the driver cannot see you. Do not live beside the trailer. Be in his glass, or be gone.

source.psdp_skill: Skill nine: multi-lane roads – part one
source.teaching_target: Stay out of a truck's blind zones; if you cannot see the driver's mirrors, you are invisible.

image_brief.subject: dirty west-coast mirrors on a rogue semi, no Ledger reflected in them, trailer filling the glass
image_brief.midground: Old Ninety's left-side glass empty of you, trailer ribs, no door marks
image_brief.read: his mirrors do not have you in them; you are in a room he cannot see

geometry.ego_lane_side: left travel lane of two northbound highway lanes
geometry.ego_nose_in_frame: not in the mirror; the reflection is the truck beside and behind
